SemanticDecisionPolicy.description: Deterministic policy over typed answers, including explicit uncertainty behavior.

SemanticExample.description: An explicit reference example included in a definition's inference state.

SemanticStatementAnswer.description: A graded truth value, not a confidence estimate.
SemanticStatementAnswer.title: SemanticStatementAnswer

SemanticStatementRule.description: Apply a threshold without treating truth value as confidence.

SemanticScoreAnswer.description: An ordered-rubric score retaining distribution and legend.

SemanticScoreRule.description: Match an inclusive rubric interval with an optional confidence gate.
SemanticScoreRule.title: SemanticScoreRule

SemanticStateBinding.description: Bind Step evidence without allowing the caller to elevate its origin.
SemanticStateBinding.title: SemanticStateBinding
